whatThisIs: Decisions by the decision owner about what a route may deliver at all. This is a different question from whether a packet is complete: a packet can be internally perfect and still deliver the wrong instrument, and no amount of proof about its bytes answers that. A refusal here outranks a packet proof, because the proof was of an artifact the owner has said may not be delivered.
howItIsApplied: generate.mjs reads this file. A family with a live refusal is placed in WRONG_DELIVERY_TYPE ahead of every proven state, so it cannot sit in COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN, cannot enter a route cohort, and cannot carry commercial eligibility. Payment was already fail-closed and stays so.

decisions.decision: LegalEase may not replace the mandatory SCCA 223A1 GS order form with its custom pleading.
whatWasMeasuredBeforeTheDecision: the string 223A1 appears in no file in the family directory and nowhere in the rendered canonical fixture; the only form the packet names is SCCA 223C, on one route
the rendered componentSet carries no official_form_reference, no records_checklist and no fee_instrument_schedule on any route, while production-field-map.json declares each of them nine times
eleven of the twelve tracks in the SC legal design memo carry destination.kind prosecutor, and the rendered packet is captioned IN THE ......... COURT and asks this court for relief

the memo states for every route that the composed package is not a substitute for the official order form, and that section 17-22-930 makes the solicitor's blank form mandatory and to the exclusion of all other expungement forms
consequences: removed from the first Grade A route cohort
COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN invalidated; the family is WRONG_DELIVERY_TYPE
every affected route removed from custom-pleading commercial eligibility

theSplitTreatmentOrdered.A: Where the mandatory official form is available and participant-filed: use the official form, include every required supporting component, the official-form reference, the records checklist and the fee-instrument schedule, give accurate solicitor-destination instructions, then build and independently verify.
theSplitTreatmentOrdered.B: Where the solicitor supplies, controls or initiates the mandatory form: HANDOFF_READY or GUIDANCE_READY, naming the correct solicitor's office and what the participant must bring or request, stating plainly that LegalEase does not replace the solicitor's mandatory form, with packet checkout disabled.
theSplitTreatmentOrdered.C: Only routes genuinely filed as court petitions may use a court-captioned pleading seeking relief from the court.

whatMayNotBeDone: preserving the current custom pleading because it already has fixtures and visual bundles
a cosmetic repair on a wrong delivery type
decisions.visualReviewInstruction: Neither South Carolina bundle is to be reviewed. Both were published before this decision and are superseded by it.

decisions.raisedBy: Claude Code Captain, from FIX13's anchor comparison
decisions.whyThisIsHereAndNotInANewQueue: Delivery type is the owner's call, and this record is where those calls live. Nothing here decides anything.
decisions.theQuestion: Each of these three routes is recorded in the route-obligation census as one a participant may not initiate, and each has a composed participant petition built for it. Which is right?

whatTheCensusSays.participantFacingInstrument: no participant filing -- attorney or qualified legal-assistance handoff

whatTheRepositoryHasBuilt.delivered: a composed petition and filing instructions, rendered to canonical.pdf and boundary.pdf in each family directory

decisions.theContradictionIsInsideTheCensusRowItse: The same row carries participantCanInitiate false and currentServiceDisposition paid_packet_intended. One of those two is wrong and the record does not say which.
decisions.howItWasFound: FIX13 was dispatched to refresh stale whole-file pins and refused these three. Their single bound census route row had not merely drifted -- it was RECLASSIFIED underneath them: A_MUST_FULFILL to B_LEGITIMATE_EXCLUSION, custom_pleading to process_guidance, participantCanInitiate true to false, contract participant_packet to referral, with reasons UNSUITABLE_FOR_SELF_HELP and COURT_INITIATED. Refreshing the pin would have written 'anchors identical' over exactly that reclassification and made a substantive change look like bookkeeping.
whatIsNotAtRiskToday: no route is open: all three are LAUNCH_GRAPH_CLOSED and none is operationally sellable
no packet can be generated: each family's build-status records generationAllowed false and runtimeSelectable false

the Nevada packet leads its SELF_HELP_STOP with the census's own point, in the compiled profile's words -- that this pathway should be routed to legal aid or an attorney because it can involve vacating the conviction, not just sealing it
decisions.whyItStillNeedsAnswering: A composed petition exists for a route the census says produces no participant filing. While the route is closed that is a contradiction on paper; if the route is ever opened on the strength of the packet being built, it becomes an invitation to self-file where the record says an attorney is required. The safe order is to settle the delivery type before anything reaches a participant.

theTwoAnswersAndWhatEachMeans.referral: The census is right. The three families are re-treated as handoff or guidance products, the composed petitions are preserved as evidence rather than as deliverables, and no participant filing ships on these routes. Precedent: the WRONG_DELIVERY_TYPE treatment already recorded in this file.
theTwoAnswersAndWhatEachMeans.participantPacket: The census rows are wrong and must be corrected -- participantCanInitiate, participantFacingInstrument, destination, currentOutputStrategy and the route contract all restated -- before the packets can advance. Until then the pins stay stale, because a stale pin is the honest state.

decisions.whatMustNotHappenMeanwhile: The receipt pins on these three families must not be refreshed. A refresh asserts the bound content is unchanged, and it changed.

grantsNothing: This file records refusals. It approves no family, opens no route and creates no commercial authority.
